description: Application for a non-material amendment following a grant of planning permission 24/01224/FUL (Demolition of existing buildings and construction of a part 6/part 8/part 10 storey building comprising social science incubator space (Class E(g)(i)) on the ground floor with ancillary cafe, light industrial employment space (Class E(g)(iii) on the lower ground floor, with halls of residence and ancillary facilities above (sui generis), with provision of associated cycle parking, new public realm, loading bay and landscaping) granted on 22.08.2025.Original condition states: Prior to the first occupation of the units herby permitted, evidence shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority to validate the measures at the as built stage to demonstrate that an urban greening factor of 0.4 or more has been achieved. Amendment sought:Revise the wording of Condition 41 (Urban Greening Factor) to require evidence that the maximum possible UGF score has been achieved.
